title: Intelligence source says Netflix's Dark mirrors the true UFO program
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Intelligence source says Netflix's Dark mirrors the true UFO program, about unspecified at United States (no place named), and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: show called Dark, and according to Jay Anderson at Project Unity, a senior member of the American intelligence community told him that the show almost perfectly encapsulates the true UFO program.

plain: Jesse Michels, a podcast host, passes on something said by Jay Anderson of a UFO research group called Project Unity. According to Anderson, a senior member of the American intelligence community told him that Dark, a television series on Netflix, almost perfectly captures what the real, secret UFO program is like. If true, it would mean a piece of fiction is a close map of a hidden government effort.
